unverified_leads.note: Older i-PRO/Panasonic firmware variant WITHOUT the 'Src/' prefix. Widely deployed and cross-listed by integrators (ispyconnect/Agent DVR), but the i-PRO Command Interface spec ver1.09 documents the path only in its 'Src/MediaInput/...' form. Kept unverified until confirmed against a firmware-specific Panasonic doc.

Legacy Panasonic BB-HCM / BL-C series MPEG-4 URL (e.g. /nphMpeg4/g726-640x480 with G.726 audio, or nil-<WxH> for no audio). Attested by Crestron/ZoneMinder integrator reports and the leads (nphMpeg4/g726-640x48), but I could not render the exact string from a Panasonic-hosted manual PDF, so not marked verified. Applies only to the old consumer BB/BL MPEG-4 cameras, NOT the current i-PRO H.264/H.265 line.

ONVIF media profile endpoint (also /ONVIF/MediaInput?profile=def_profile1 etc.). Standard ONVIF, resolved via ONVIF Media service GetStreamUri rather than a fixed manufacturer RTSP URL — not a Panasonic-specific fixed path, so left unverified here.
Not present in the i-PRO Command Interface RTSP URL chapter; likely cross-brand contamination. Excluded.
Generic SDP endpoint, not documented for Panasonic/i-PRO. Cross-brand contamination. Excluded.

notes: Panasonic Security is now i-PRO Co., Ltd. Current/official RTSP scheme (i-PRO Command Interface spec, Section 2.3.3): rtsp://{ip}:554/Src/MediaInput/stream_<N> for N=1..4 (codec-agnostic, follows the per-stream encode profile H.264 or H.265). A legacy H.264-only form /Src/MediaInput/h264/stream_<N> (and /Src/MediaInput/h264) is also officially documented and returns error 503 if the stream is not set to H.264. Multi-sensor / Fisheye-quad models append /ch_<N> (e.g. /Src/MediaInput/stream_1/ch_1). Requesting rtsp://{ip}/Src/MediaInput with stream+ch omitted returns the configured Initial Stream. Default RTSP port 554. Legacy consumer BB-HCM/BL-C MPEG-4 cameras used /nphMpeg4/g726-<WxH> (recorded under unverified_leads pending a Panasonic-own manual).
